title: Minton's, Teddy Hill and the music
summary: He did not care for the crowd at Minton's but says Teddy Hill had good bands.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: When you mentioned about all of the junkies around Minton's and whatnot, how about the music that they played? Teddy Hill was the manager of the club at that time and that was an old band buddy of yours. Like you say, you were living right here, right up the street.
Yeah, but I don't know, I didn't care too much about it.
About the gang that goes in there.
He had good bands in there.
